comparison.objective: Finish painting only bare panel regions while avoiding excess repainting and table contamination; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires roller contact control, coverage planning and avoidance of already-painted areas. Candidate requires precision tool engagement, fine retained rotation and iterative dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores bare-cell coverage, wasted overlap and forbidden paint contact. Candidate scores stopping behavior and lock retention, with several response thresholds unspecified.
comparison.reason: Selective surface coverage tests a fundamentally different physical ability from mechanical adjustment and commissioning.
